body: `generateManualPasswordLink` inserts a token for any `userId` without verifying that the user exists (or is not deleted). This can create orphan tokens and return a link that will later fail (or partially run) in the set-password endpoint. Consider fetching the user first and returning a clear error if the user is missing/deleted/ineligible before inserting into `verification_tokens`.

This endpoint now hard-filters users to `examType='mppsc'`. If the intent is to support admin filtering by exam type (as described), consider reading `examType` from the request (query param) with validation and a safe default, rather than hardcoding it here. Otherwise, admins will not be able to view/manage non-MPPSC users via this API.

`generateManualPasswordLink` reuses the public `/api/auth/set-password` flow, which currently derives `planTier` from the most recent payment and falls back to `'pro'` when no payment exists. With a manually generated token for an arbitrary userId, this can unintentionally grant Pro access (and set `isSubscribed=true`) to users without a captured payment. Please add a guard before issuing the token (e.g., require a latest **captured** payment / non-free plan) and/or adjust the set-password flow so it never defaults to upgrading access when payment data is missing.
